easy.def: A time when you rest and do not go to school or work.
easy.example: We went to the beach on vacation.

more.def: A time of rest away from school or work, often spent on a trip.
more.example: Our family spent summer vacation camping in the mountains.

more.def: Worth a lot of money, or very important and useful.
more.example: Her advice was valuable because it helped me solve the problem.

easy.def: To go away so no one can see it.
easy.example: The magician made the coin vanish.

more.example: The deer vanished into the forest before I could take a picture.
The garden has flowers of various colors and sizes.

easy.def: A thing that takes people from place to place, like a car or bus.
easy.example: A truck is a big vehicle.

more.def: A machine such as a car, bus, or truck that carries people or things.
more.example: Only emergency vehicles may park in front of the hospital.

easy.example: Our team cheered after the victory.

more.def: The act of winning a game, contest, or battle.
more.example: The team's victory was their first of the season.

easy.example: My grandma lives in a village.

more.def: A small group of houses and buildings, smaller than a town.
more.example: The village had one school, one shop, and a tiny post office.

easy.def: A person who comes to see you or a place.
easy.example: We have a visitor at our house.

more.def: A person who goes to see someone or to spend time in a place.
more.example: Visitors to the park must stay on the trails.

easy.def: A mountain that can shoot out hot melted rock.
easy.example: The volcano had smoke on top.

more.def: A mountain with an opening where melted rock, ash, and gas can burst out.
more.example: When the volcano erupted, lava flowed down its sides.

easy.def: A long trip on a ship or in space.
easy.example: The ship went on a long voyage.

more.def: A long journey, especially by sea or through space.
more.example: The voyage across the ocean took three weeks.
